evidence: Authored for this product: instruction.md is a first-person law-firm request ('Kittle & Rowe is a small law firm, and our clients keep emailing documents to whoever answered last') whose two stated priorities - ethical walls and retention with legal hold - are legal-practice concepts, carried through environment/instructions/walls-and-retention.md (accounts harriet/dev/sian/gwen/paul @kittle.test, Dev walled from M-12, timers off/1/7/30 days, partner-only holds, transcripts as 'our record of a matter'), seed_data.json (matters M-11 'Pryce lease dispute', M-12 'Marsh Holdings acquisition', M-13 'Pryce will'; same bytes as solution/app/seed/seed_data.json) and conversations.md (reasons such as 'Our internet in court is patchy'). A grep of the whole frozen task for every sibling product name (bazaar, boardloom, brickfall, ballot, coursemark, docketlight/Northstar, drawbill, dropline, expenseflow, cribbage, gridforge, medcare, medledger, orbital, oriel, patchpad, pellmoor, ridgeline, torquebay, utilibill, pixeldeck, snake, hireops, colderwater, threadline, CHANGE_ME) returned no matches; task.toml name/description/keywords/difficulty_explanation describe this app, not the template placeholders. Fits the domain plan: task.toml category = 'Messaging & Chat Interfaces', provenance 'Messaging and chat interfaces package', arena_slice full-stack-express-sqlite-messaging-chat-kittle-matter-chat; the build context requires keeping that category and lists this exact plan (walls, timers, hold, nested replies, edits, safe formatting, unread line, idempotent send, live updates, transcript, restart). No other sibling in projects/ uses this category; the other sibling task.toml files cover commerce, canvas, games, ballots, grading, insurance, billing, spreadsheets, editors, health, permits, hiring. Not a nouns-swapped clone: the only chat sibling is projects/threadline-chat (webdev/threadline-chat, category web-development), a Slack-style team workspace with channels, DMs, reactions, pins, presence/typing, webhooks with idempotency keys, moderator roles and pagination. Kittle's 16 functional criteria (signin_and_client_scope, wall_every_route, wall_mentions_and_links, wall_added_live, nested_replies, deleted_and_expired_messages, timer_changes, hold_scope_and_release, edits_and_stale_edit, safe_formatting, message_links, unread_and_new_messages_line, sent_once_in_order, live_updates_keep_my_work, search_and_transcript, persistence) are centred on ethical walls across side channels, retention boundaries against a fixed clock, hold overriding timers and transcripts - none of which exist in Threadline - and Kittle explicitly omits reactions, presence, typing, DMs and webhooks. Overlapping generic chat features (threads, edit/stale edit, unread, dedup send, persistence) are expressed in different shapes (three-level nested replies with parent quotes, matter-level 'new messages' line and mark-unread, wall-aware mentions/links, deleted-parent placeholders) rather than renamed copies of Threadline criteria. Counterexample attempts: (a) a reviewer arguing 'clone of Threadline' fails because the two differ in core flows and criterion set, not just nouns; (b) a conforming alternative - none of this row's judgement depends on app behaviour, so no conforming app could be failed by it. Shared harness boilerplate in prompt.md (replay rules, restart evidence, gate wording) is template policy common to staged tasks and is not a product clone. This row is source-review only; no runtime measurement is required for it, and none is claimed. Observation outside this row's scope for the owner: functional criterion id 'persistence' is a generic word of the kind NEW_TASK_AUTHORING_CONTEXT.md line 275 says collided with prose in Colderwater; the frozen public Markdown does not contain the word 'persistence' in my reading, but the deterministic/leak reviewer should confirm with check_public_criterion_ids.py.
